text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Tamamo Cross—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look!
Isn't that one of those "Paka Puchi" things!?
Looking in the direction Tamamo Cross points, I see a claw crane machine filled with plushies themed after the Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Right ya are, the kiddos, y'see.
Apparently it's all the rage at school right now.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ah... how much cash do I have on me?
If I can get it in one shot, it's 100 yen, right?
choice_data_list: Still, if you get sucked down that rabbit hole...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Even if I bet 100, 200, no, 1000 yen...!
Ababababa...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-What are you making me do?! Help me visualize success here!!
choice_data_list: Well, I've got some great news for you.
We have a great deal for someone like you

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oho? Talk about a tease.
Alright, let's hear it.
choice_data_list: I'll give it a try with my own money instead!
I'll take your place and pay out of my own pocket to try!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whaat!? For real!?
You spent your own pocket money on this...!?

Leaving a flustered Tamamo Cross behind,
I inserted a coin into the crane game.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer... You're really somethin' else...! Guhh... I'm gonna cheer ya on with everything I've got!!
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
